name: Feicui Yue
source:
official site https://www.sp-time.com/works/feicuiyue (broken but there are archived copies)

Summary
The protagonist got disfigured and lost his parents and elder sister in an accident. He got immured by his clansmen who considered him a shame to the whole clan. One night when the ground is shrounded by jade-colored moonlight, in the mountain appears a strange light. Attracted by the light, the protagonist comes to the mountain and meets a blind girl, Feicui Yue (Jade Moon).

(translated from https://www.cngal.org/entries/index/185)
translation:
主人公在一场事故中毁容，并失去了父母与姐姐。族人认为他是整个家族的耻辱，将他活埋。某晚，玉色月光笼罩大地，山中出现奇异光芒。主人公被光芒吸引，来到山里，遇见一名失明女孩——翡翠月。

（译自CNGAL：https://www.cngal.org/entries/index/185）
